name: Button
description: A native action with explicit hierarchy and progress feedback.
states: Primary · secondary · ghost · danger · busy · disabled

name: IconButton
description: Compact actions keep an accessible name and a consistent touch target.

name: Field
description: Labeled inputs and prose fields share validation, help, and error placement.
states: Text · email · textarea · required · readonly · disabled

name: Checkbox
description: A native checkbox combines its label, helper text, and selected value.

name: Select
description: Native selection keeps labels and disabled choices predictable.
states: Selected option · disabled option · disabled field

name: SegmentedControl
description: A small set of mutually exclusive choices, implemented as native radios.

name: Tabs
description: Related panels use arrow-key navigation while editable data stays with the owner.
states: Selected panel · disabled tab · preserved field value

name: Badge
description: Status meaning stays visible in text across every semantic tone.

name: Progress
description: Counts and a labeled progress bar describe the same goal.

name: EmptyState
description: An empty surface explains what is missing and offers a relevant next action.

name: Notice
description: Feedback pairs a clear result with a next step when one is needed.
states: Information · success · warning · error with retry

name: Dialog
description: A focused form with a title, validation, footer actions, and a return path.

name: Panel
description: A reusable surface with an independent heading, content area, and action slot.

name: BeatItem
description: A numbered beat opens onto a full manuscript page with the existing Tiptap writing behavior.
states: Collapsed · expanded · rich text · formatting · undo/redo · read only

name: ManuscriptSurface
description: A reading surface preserves the paper treatment within either theme.

name: StatGroup
description: Values, captions, and attached units form a responsive summary.

name: NavigationTree
description: Expandable groups and active scene selection retain the manuscript hierarchy.
states: Expanded group · collapsed group · selected leaf · disabled leaf

name: TagPicker
description: Existing tag IDs can be filtered, selected, and removed without moving persistence into the UI.
states: Selected tags · filtering · removal · no matches

name: Menu
description: Secondary commands appear in a keyboard-operable disclosure.

name: CommandPalette
description: Search commands, navigate results with arrow keys, and invoke an explicit callback.

name: ShortcutRecorder
description: Record a local key combination while respecting cancellation and reserved shortcuts.

name: SearchResults
description: Query highlighting, full details, pagination, and an empty state share one result list.
states: Filtered · highlighted · paginated · empty · selected result
